 AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Leaked Trailer Description Teases a Brutal X-Men Battle, Wolverine, Deadpool, and Total Multiverse Destruction
 Movie 
 Avengers: Doomsday Marve MCUI Image Safe 
 about 4 hours ago by Joey Paur 
 Marvel Studios might be getting ready to unleash absolute hell with its next Avengers: Doomsday trailer, and if a leaked description making the rounds online is legit, Doctor Doom is about to tear the MCU apart.
 Following Empire's recent coverage of Avengers: Doomsday , fans are expecting a new trailer to arrive next week. Marvel has followed similar promotional patterns before, and now a rumored breakdown of the footage has surfaced, teasing a massive showdown involving the Avengers, X-Men, Fantastic Four, and a few familiar mutants.
 Of course, this is an unverified leak, so don't go betting your comic book collection on it. Still, the details sound pretty damn awesome.
 According to the description, the trailer kicks off in Latveria, giving fans their first look at Doomstadt. The sky is completely black, green mist surrounds Doom's castle, and even the Marvel Studios logo has that sinister green makeover.
 From there, we jump back to Earth-616, where an extended scene shows Steve Rogers reuniting with Thor. Steve reportedly narrates a series of massive battles as different worlds begin colliding, with Captain America, Thor, and Reed Richards confronting Doctor Doom.
 Nightcrawler and Beast also appear during the montage, bringing the X-Men further into the conflict.
 Things get a little more crazy when Cyclops fires a full-powered optic blast directly at Doom. Unfortunately for Scott Summers, Doom fires back with an attack so devastating that it nearly kills the mutant leader.
 The footage then shifts to a voiceover from Florence Pugh , although the description doesn't reveal what she says. We also get a look at God Loki sitting on his throne, visibly terrified by something happening off-screen. Whatever has the God of Stories looking scared can't be good.
 Magneto gets his own battle sequence before the trailer brings in two characters fans have been waiting to see return with Wolverine and Deadpool.
 Hugh Jackman and Ryan Reynolds are widely expected to reprise their roles, and the rumored footage apparently shows them back in action. Even more interesting, webs can be spotted in the background. Spider-Man, anyone?
 The description doesn't identify who's responsible for those webs, but Marvel knows exactly what kind of reaction a tease like that would get.
 Unfortunately, the excitement doesn't last long before things go completely sideways.
 Earth-10005, the universe associated with Deadpool and Wolverine, is reportedly destroyed. That's followed by the destruction of Avengers Tower and the Baxter Building, suggesting Doom isn't interested in leaving much standing when he's finished.
 The trailer apparently saves one of its biggest moments for the end, revealing millions of Doombots charging toward the assembled Avengers.
 If Marvel actually delivers even half of what's described here, we're looking at one hell of a superhero war.
 What makes this rumored Avengers: Doomsday trailer so interesting is how much destruction it supposedly reveals. We're not just talking about superheroes punching each other through buildings. 
 Entire realities are getting wiped out, major Marvel landmarks are being demolished, and some of the MCU's most powerful characters appear completely outmatched.
 Again, none of this has been officially confirmed, and leaked trailer descriptions have a habit of getting fans excited over footage that never materializes. We'll have to wait and see whether Marvel's next preview actually delivers these moments.
 Avengers: Doomsday hits theaters on December 18.
